actual_beta_one_realization.lower_assignment: d == 0 (mod 3410), after the coordinate-11 center has been fixed inside the d==0 (mod 310) chain fiber

actual_dual_anchor_beta_one_realization.name: one common-residue system with one exact beta-one fiber at each anchor
actual_dual_anchor_beta_one_realization.scope: Positive pointwise compatibility only: the anchor-dependent fibers do not establish uniform lower-coordinate saturation or a complete certificate.

both_anchor_policy: Anchorwise cylinder choices are not independent: every row must pass the exact common-residue congruence before a two-anchor template is called realizable.

separately_realizable_but_not_common.reason: mod q, anchor 0 requires r==2 while anchor 1 requires r==4
separately_realizable_but_not_common.scope: This blocks the prescribed use of one fixed rigid row; it does not rule out a larger system with additional rows.

feasibility.bounded_absence_warning: No qualifying largest-coordinate depth e>=2 was found for q<=500000; this is finite evidence only.

resource_lemma.ambient_beta: If no covering row has l-order depth beta, an additional admitted support row with v_l(ord_q(5))>=beta is required to create the ambient coordinate.
resource_lemma.dynamic: A dynamic l-row requires l==3 mod4, l!=5, K_l>=s_l+m, and accepted shell indices j only where s_l+j is positive odd.
resource_lemma.rigid: N_e active rigid cylinders at coordinate l and depth e require N_e distinct primes q with q==3 mod4, s_q>=2, P+(ord_q(5))=l, and v_l(ord_q(5))=e.

universal_impossibility_example.abstract_template: dynamic beta-one shell at coordinate l=5 plus one centered rigid digit
universal_impossibility_example.reason: the formal class admits dynamic rows only at primes p == 3 (mod 4), p != 5

local_zero_policy: A value zero modulo p^K has clipped valuation None and is never accepted; the actual 67/20771 fiber test checks the dynamic center is covered only by the rigid row.

complexity_estimate.asymptotic_description: O(B log log B) sieve plus trial-division factor/order work over the frozen candidate set
complexity_estimate.method: sieve to bound; factor q-1; exact order reduction; one modular exponentiation modulo q^2 for nonregularity

separate_anchor_beta_one_class_zero.name: separately realizable prescribed beta-one class-zero fibers, not one common-residue system
separate_anchor_beta_one_class_zero.scope: This excludes the prescribed class-zero pair. It does not exclude other class choices or larger systems.

unrealizable_q7_rigid_label.name: q=7 cannot supply a positive odd rigid valuation
unrealizable_q7_rigid_label.reason: Although 3 divides ord_7(5)=6, s_7=1 leaves no positive odd h<s_7.
